# Review

## Outcome

**Approved**

## Evidence

- All 109 workspace tests pass (8 concentration_helpers, 5 save_load, 6 unit, 5 ambient_temperature, 5 chemistry, 7 cycling, 1 determinism, 3 dissolved_oxygen, 17 end_to_end, 6 events, 8 water_change_mass_balance, 7 materialization, 2 startup_overrides, etc.)
- All 15 concentration helpers implemented on WaterState (tan_mg_n_per_l, nitrite_mg_n_per_l, nitrate_mg_n_per_l, don_mg_n_per_l, doc_mg_c_per_l, dic_mg_c_per_l, do_mg_per_l, phosphate_mg_p_per_l, alkalinity_meq_per_l, calcium_mg_per_l, magnesium_mg_per_l, gh_d, kh_d, tds_mg_per_l, conductivity_us_cm) with matching TankState wrappers at state.rs:188-244
- water_volume_l() on TankState (state.rs:182-186) computes net volume via geometry.water_volume_l_with_substrate_depth(substrate_depth_cm()).max(0.0) — confirmed correct
- concentration() helper (water.rs:222-228) guards against zero, epsilon, and non-finite volume by returning 0.0; all helpers chain through .max(0.0) for non-negativity
- proptest (concentration_helpers.rs:259-333) covers all 15 helpers plus substrate_volume_l and water_volume_l with 256 random cases including substrate_depth > fill_height
- don_mg_n_per_l() added to WaterState (water.rs:128) and TankState (state.rs:200) — fills gap for dissolved organic nitrogen
- kh_d() added to WaterState (water.rs:167) and TankState (state.rs:236) — snapshot.rs:73 now uses state.kh_d() instead of inline (alkalinity * 50.0) / 17.848
- seeded_example() (state.rs:105-141) captures old_volume_l before substrate replacement, rescales totals via water.rescale_totals_for_volume(old_volume_l, volume_l), and reseeds stability_tracker — verified at lines 107, 135-139
- SCHEMA_VERSION bumped to 3 (save.rs:10) with explanatory comment; from_json() rejects non-3 versions including schema-2 saves via SchemaVersionMismatch error (save.rs:43-47)
- WaterState::default_for_geometry (water.rs:66) and from_source_profile (water.rs:72-81) now require substrate_depth_cm parameter and compute net volume via geometry.water_volume_l_with_substrate_depth(substrate_depth_cm)
- WaterState::default() (water.rs:215-220) uses SubstrateLayerState::default().depth_cm for consistent net-volume seeding
- Zero geometry.water_volume_l() calls remain in src/ — all chemistry paths migrated to TankState::water_volume_l()
- Remaining raw _total/volume_l patterns (chemistry.rs:15 standalone fn, nitrogen_cycle.rs:384-386 detritus densities, microfauna.rs:21) are correctly scoped to non-chemistry density calculations
- cargo fmt --all --check passes with no diffs
- Only pre-existing clippy warning (derivable_impls in tank_scenarios::StartupOverrides) — unrelated to this changeset

## Findings and Gaps

- Pre-existing clippy::derivable_impls warning in tank_scenarios::StartupOverrides (crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:191) is unrelated to this bead but should be fixed in a housekeeping pass
- The canonical_helpers_use_net_water_volume unit test verifies specific expected values for most helpers but the 'very large tank' test (helpers_remain_stable_for_very_large_tanks) only checks non-negativity and finiteness rather than expected values — this is adequate for its purpose but less precise than the canonical test

## Follow-up and Amendments

- Pre-existing clippy derivable_impls warning in tank_scenarios::StartupOverrides should be addressed in a separate housekeeping pass
